entities.name: Query Nnr/YjeF protein
observations: 524 aa bacterial protein; predicted molecular mass 53.85 kDa and theoretical pI 5.44.
Contains YjeF_N domain (PF03853) at positions 27–194 and Carb_kinase domain (PF01256) at positions 253–516.
Shows 39.2–43.0% identity over 98.5–99.2% coverage to reviewed bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr proteins.
Sequence-based assignment supports bifunctional NAD(P)HX epimerase and ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase activity.
Potassium is reported as a bound cofactor in closely matching reviewed Nnr homologs; exact binding in this sequence is inferred from homology.

entities.name: P31806
observations: Reviewed Escherichia coli bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme Nnr.
Catalyzes NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration of (S)-NAD(P)HX to regenerate NAD(P)H/NADPH, with ADP converted to AMP and phosphate.
Annotated with EC 5.1.99.6 and EC 4.2.1.136; binds one potassium ion per subunit.
Contains YjeF N-terminal and C-terminal domains.

entities.name: NAD(P)HX epimerization
observations: The enzyme interconverts (6R)-NADHX and (6S)-NADHX, and analogously (6R)-NADPHX and (6S)-NADPHX.
This is a metabolite-repair reaction for hydrated NAD(P)H cofactors.

entities.name: ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydration
observations: The enzyme converts (6S)-NADHX + ADP to NADH + AMP + phosphate + H+; the NADPH analogue is (6S)-NADPHX + ADP to NADPH + AMP + phosphate + H+.
This reaction repairs hydrated NADH/NADPH at the expense of ADP cleavage.

entities.name: NAD(P)H metabolite repair
observations: The Nnr function is associated with metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.
GO terms in reviewed homologs include GO:0110051 and GO:0046496.
